title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 8
description:

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

19:30 - Cornucopias Marketplace Walkthrough
24:43 - Another Land Size Leak
25:50 - Rob Stumbles Through Another American Sport
26:22 - Land Comparison
29:54 - Another Custom Dome Leak
30:41 -  Mobile Game Development
35:00 - Last Leak
